description: Complete security/compliance questionnaires from verified company information.
notes: Kit fallback at ../kit-fallback-w9.js; 40 questions, 37 auto-filled, 3 flagged for human review per spec

notes.note: Vendor security questionnaires are a famously soul-crushing time sink, and $199/questionnaire prices directly against the hours burned. The knowledge-base-plus-auto-fill API compounds with every questionnaire answered — that's a real data moat. Sellers hate questionnaires enough to pay; buyers of the marketplace are the scale story.
Review-queue tab filters; Approve toggles and counter 0->1; zero errors.
Normalized score schema: iteration-2 worker used thesis/magic_moment/demo_legibility/value_prop/ceiling; mapped to startup/originality/quality/usefulness/tech respectively.

iteration_notes.change: Progress bar animates 0 to 37 on load; ROI banner quantifies 13 hours and ~$2,000 saved per questionnaire
